description: Three checks on how much of this position would still stand if one thing went wrong: how many months of bills and debt payments the reachable cash would cover, the single biggest holding's share of the invested money, and unsecured debt against what could be reached. The same checks as the first three of the Money MOT (Tools > Money MOT), each in its own units - there is no overall score. Use for 'how resilient am I', 'how well spread am I', 'am I too concentrated in one thing', 'what's my biggest risk'. Says which checks couldn't be done and what to add.
name: get_resilience
title: How well spread it is
